_about: Dimethyl carbonate (1) + o-Xylene (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of dimethyl carbonate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: K. Liu, X. Xu, Y. Zhang, D. Xu, J. Gao, L. Zhang, Y. Wang, Measurement and Correlation of Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium for Binary Systems of Dimethyl Carbonate with Butyl Butyrate, o-Xylene, and Cyclohexanone at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 64 (2019) 5210-5217
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 8, 9. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.15 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
